verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web scraping and enrichment platform, so PII detection and filtering is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any PII detection, redaction, or filtering capability. Its docs instead describe extracting contact data and people (e.g., pulling every dentist from each practice), which is the opposite direction.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically detect and filter personally identifiable information out of scraped content before it reaches storage
